Alex / AuditPro team — Thanks again for the call today. Below are concise notes and action items. Recording: we recorded the session for internal tracking (redwood-call-recording-20261104.mp4). Please reply if you prefer the recording removed.

Meeting notes (summary):
- Scope: SOC2 readiness focused on log retention, access controls, and encryption-at-rest artifacts. We mapped ~12 SIG questions that need evidence pulls; Marissa will own the evidence checklist.
- Log retention: Redwood retention defaults to 30 days for inference telemetry in hosted plans; we outlined export options (daily/weekly) for audits and suggested a weekly export to your SFTP.
- Evidence path:
  * Marissa to collate config screenshots for KMS, backups, and log rotation (owners: Redwood-SecOps).
  * Alex to confirm the list of systems that must be included in the CAIQ mapping (endpoint list uploaded to sftp).
  * AuditPro to provide any template redlines they need for contract/controls language.

Agreed next steps (owners / due dates):
1) Marissa Cole (redwood) — assemble evidence checklist and share by 2026-11-08.
2) Alex Porter (marineaxis) — confirm full endpoint list and ensure sample logs are accessible by 2026-11-06.
3) AuditPro SOC2 Team — send any contract redline requests by 2026-11-12.
4) Ben Carter (redwood) — follow up on procurement timeline and provide any pricing/commitment notes needed by 2026-11-10.

Attachments uploaded to SFTP by MarineAxis: sample-logs.zip (confirmed).

If anything above is incorrect or you want additional detail, flag it in reply and we'll correct. Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene if the evidence sprint surfaces blockers.

Best,

—
